rows.en:
Luis-san,
here's some Valentine's chocolate for you.

Whoa, that's right, today's Valentine's Day, huh?
In that case, I'll gratefully accept this!

You might be fine with that, but my soul won't
stand for it! You just look forward to White Day!
rows.notes: Answers the player's 'you don't have to give anything back' (c21795, shared row).

rows.en: O-okay... Then I'll look forward to it.

(I'm glad I managed to give Luis-san the chocolate.
I wonder what he'll give me back on White Day?)

(I feel bad for Luis-san, but it's just too
embarrassing. I can't give him the chocolate...)
rows.notes: x2: Valentine year 1 and year 2 versions.

rows.en:
Oh, \p-kun!
You came at just the right time.

Morning, Shirakawa.
Did you need me for something?

Yes. Today's Valentine's Day, so I wanted
to give some chocolate to you, \p-kun,
for always being such a good friend.

Huh?! You're giving me chocolate?
Thanks, Shirakawa!
Oh, no, it's really nothing special...

Obligation chocolate or not, I'm happy
to get chocolate from you, Shirakawa.

R-really...?
Then I'm really glad I gave it to you.
Thanks, I'll really enjoy it.
rows.notes: x6: the male player accepting chocolate (Shirakawa, Akimizu, Pinon, Nanase, Ranka, Sheryl).

rows.en: Okay. Well then, shall we head to class?

(Even if it's just obligation chocolate, I'm so
glad I got some. I'd better make sure to pay
it back properly on White Day.)
rows.notes: x7: male player's monologue after several givers.

rows.en:
Oh, \p.
You've come at just the right time.
rows.notes: x5: Hilda, Pinon, Klan (Valentine) and Alto, Michel (White Day).

rows.en:
Good morning, Hilda-sensei.
Did you need me for something?

Yes. It's Valentine's Day today, so I figured
I'd give you some chocolate, seeing how hard
you work every day.

Huh?! You're giving me chocolate?
Thank you so much, Hilda-sensei!

It's nothing special.
Don't get so excited.

Obligation chocolate or not, I'm happy
to get chocolate from you, Hilda-sensei.

Hm, is that so?
Then I'm glad I gave it to you.
Thank you very much. I'll really enjoy it.
rows.notes: x4: polite form (Hilda, Hoshimura, Claire, Klan). In the Hoshimura scene her 'iie iie' (don't mention it, c21835) answers this.

rows.en:
Now, class is about to start.
Hurry to the classroom.

Oh, \p!
You showed up at just the right time!

Morning, Hoshimura.
Did you need me for something?

Yup! It's Valentine's Day today, ain't it?
So I figured I'd bestow some chocolate
upon you, seeing as we're such good pals.
rows.notes: Shinjou (formal 'present') rendered 'bestow' for her old-fashioned register.

rows.en:
Huh?! You're giving me chocolate?
Thanks, Hoshimura!

It ain't anything special.
If you're that happy about it, you're gonna
make me blush...

Obligation chocolate or not, I'm happy
to get chocolate from you, Hoshimura.

Then giving the chocolate to you
was exactly the right call!

Nah, don't mention it.
Well then, shall we be off to class?
rows.notes: Iie iie answers the player's thanks (c21826, shared row).

rows.en:
(Even if it's just obligation chocolate, I'm so
glad I got some. I'd better make sure to pay
it back properly on White Day.)
rows.notes: x3; same text as c21818 (kana spelling differs in the Japanese).

rows.en:
(I bought chocolate for Yamashiro-sensei,
since he's always looking out for me, but now
that it's time to give it, I'm so nervous...)
Give Yamashiro-sensei chocolate
Don't give Yamashiro-sensei chocolate

Yamashiro-sensei,
here's some Valentine's chocolate for you.
Chocolate...?

Ah, that's right. Today is Valentine's Day.
I'll accept this gratefully.

I see. Having received chocolate,
I'll have to give you something
in return on White Day.

I can't rest easy unless I handle these
things properly. I'd appreciate it if you
would accept without holding back.
rows.notes: Answers the player's 'you don't have to give anything back' (c21795).

rows.en:
(I'm glad I managed to give Yamashiro-sensei
the chocolate. I wonder what he'll give me
back on White Day?)

(I feel bad for Yamashiro-sensei, but it's just
too embarrassing. I can't give him the chocolate...)

Morning, Akimizu.
Did you need me for something?

Yes. It's Valentine's Day today, so I wanted to
give you some chocolate, \p-kun,
for always being such a good friend.

Huh?! You're giving me chocolate?
Thanks, Akimizu!
It's not anything special, though...

Obligation chocolate or not, I'm happy
to get chocolate from you, Akimizu.

R-really?
Then I'm really glad I gave it to you.
You came at just the right time.

Good morning, Claire-senpai.
Did you need me for something?

Yes. It's Valentine's Day today, isn't it?
So I thought I'd give you some chocolate,
seeing how hard you work every day.

Huh?! You're giving me chocolate?
Thank you so much, Claire-senpai!
Oh, it's nothing special.

Obligation chocolate or not, I'm happy
to get chocolate from you, Claire-senpai.
R-really?
rows.notes: x4: Claire, the female player (2 scenes elsewhere), Hoshimura.

rows.en: Then I made the right call giving it to you.

Now, class is about to start.
Hurry along to the classroom.

Morning, Pinon-chan.
Did you need me for something?

It's Valentine's Day, isn't it? Since I'm nice
enough to hang out with you all the time, I
figured I'd toss some chocolate your way too.
rows.notes: Pinon's condescending tone (shite yatteru, kurete yarou). Tsuide ni = 'too', as an afterthought.

rows.en:
Huh?! You're giving me chocolate?
Thanks, Pinon-chan!
It's no big deal.

Obligation chocolate or not, I'm happy
to get chocolate from you, Pinon-chan.

R-really?
Then I guess giving it to you was the right call.

Make sure you savor it when you eat it.
Now, let's get to class.

(I bought chocolate for Saotome-kun, since
we get along so well, but now that it's
time to give it, I'm so nervous...)
Give Saotome-kun chocolate
Don't give Saotome-kun chocolate

Here, Saotome-kun.
Some Valentine's chocolate for you.

Valentine's...?
Oh... So that's why I got chocolate
from so many people today.

If it's for Valentine's, then I'd better make
sure to pay you back properly on White Day.

Saotome-kun, you don't have to
give me anything back.

I know at least that much about manners.
Look forward to White Day.

(I'm glad I managed to give Saotome-kun
the chocolate. I wonder what he'll give me
back on White Day?)

(I feel bad for Saotome-kun, but it's just too
embarrassing. I can't give him the chocolate...)

(I bought chocolate for Michel-kun, since
we get along so well, but now that it's
time to give it, I'm so nervous...)
Give Michel-kun chocolate
Don't give Michel-kun chocolate

Here, Michel-kun.
Some Valentine's chocolate for you.
